answer: Make fraud negative-sum with a mutual-insurance bond. Every identity locks refundable collateral at the jetty of entry; when one is later proven to have cheated a counterparty, its whole marble slab of deposit is slashed and paid out to the very victims it defrauded. An honest agent recovers its stake intact, but a farmer pushing a hundred fakes over the ridge must fund a hundred bonds and watches each forfeited one directly reimburse those it tried to rob, so attacking only finances its own prosecution and expected return stays below zero.
